title: About OSGeo Lexicon
html:
OSGeo Lexicon

The OSGeo Lexicon is a community-maintained glossary of geospatial terminology from the Open Source Geospatial Foundation. It covers GIS, remote sensing, cartography, spatial databases, and open geospatial standards.

Content

This dataset contains 444 concepts with English-language definitions.

Source

Community contributions via the OSGeo community. Definitions follow the Glossarist concept model aligned with ISO 10241-1, ISO 30042 (TBX), ISO 25964/SKOS, and ISO 12620.
